title: Indrajit comes back in an invisible form
introduction: A nocturnal was commences between the hostile demons and monkeys. The demons destroy some monkeys. The monkeys drag and kill elephants, chariots and their occupants. Rama and Lakshmana even in that darkness kill the foremost of demons. As a result of the struggle, streams of blood flow in the battle-field. That fatal night transforms into a night of dissolution. When some demons attack Rama with arrows, Rama strikes down six of the demons within a moment and they run away for life. Rama then clears off innumerable demons from the battle filed. Angada strikes Indrajit, his chariot and the charioteer all at once, but Indrajit vanishes from the spot. Sugreeva and his monkeys feel delighted and praise Angada's prowess. Indrajit comes back in an invisible form and by recourse to magic, makes Rama and Lakshmana captive by hurling a net work of serpentine around them.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे चतुश्चत्वारिंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 44th Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
युध्यताम् एव तेषाम् तु तदा वानर रक्षसाम् |
रविर् अस्तम् गतो रात्रिह् प्रवृत्ता प्राण हारिणी
verses.iast:
yudhyatām eva teṣām tu tadā vānara rakṣasām |
ravir astam gato rātrih pravṛttā prāṇa hāriṇī
verses.translation: While those monkeys and demons were fighting, the sun sank below the horizon, setting in motion a night of carnage.

verses.devanagari:
अन्योन्यम् बद्ध वैराणाम् घोराणाम् जयम् इच्चताम् |
सम्प्रवृत्तम् निशाअ युद्धम् तदा वारण रक्षसाम्
verses.iast:
anyonyam baddha vairāṇām ghorāṇām jayam iccatām |
sampravṛttam niśāa yuddham tadā vāraṇa rakṣasām
verses.translation: Then, a nocturnal was commenced between the terrific monkeys and demons, who contracted hostility with each other, wishing for their victory.

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसो असि इति हरयो हरिश च असि इति राक्षसाः |
अन्योन्यम् समरे जघ्नुस् तस्मिंस् तमसि दारुणे
verses.iast:
rākṣaso asi iti harayo hariśa ca asi iti rākṣasāḥ |
anyonyam samare jaghnus tasmiṃs tamasi dāruṇe
verses.translation: "You are a demon" said the monkeys "You are a monkey" said the demons and killed at each other in battle; during that dreadful darkness.

verses.devanagari:
जहि दारय च एति इति कथम् विद्रवसि इति च |
एवम् सुतुमुलह् शाब्दस् तस्मिंस् तमसि शौशरुवे
verses.iast:
jahi dāraya ca eti iti katham vidravasi iti ca |
evam sutumulah śābdas tasmiṃs tamasi śauśaruve
verses.translation: "Strike!" "Tear asunder!" "come near!" "Why are you running away?" - very tumultuous sounds like this could be heard in that army.

verses.devanagari:
कालाह् कान्चन सम्नाहास् तस्मिंस् तमसि राक्षसाः |
सम्प्रादृशयन्त शाइल इन्द्रा दीप्त ओषधि वना;इव
verses.iast:
kālāh kāncana samnāhās tasmiṃs tamasi rākṣasāḥ |
samprādṛśayanta śāila indrā dīpta oṣadhi vanā;iva
verses.translation: The black demons in that darkness, wearing golden mails, were appearing as mountains with groves of medicinal plants emitting their light.

glosses.meaning: having groves of medicinal plants emitting their light.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मिंस् तमसि दुष्पारे राक्षसाह् क्रोध मूर्चिताः |
परिपेतुर् महा वेगा भक्षयन्तह् प्लवम् गमान्
verses.iast:
tasmiṃs tamasi duṣpāre rākṣasāh krodha mūrcitāḥ |
paripetur mahā vegā bhakṣayantah plavam gamān
verses.translation: In that darkness, which was difficult to be overcome, the demons agitated as they were with anger, attacked with great speed, duly destroying the monkeys.

glosses.meaning: which was difficult to be overcome

verses.devanagari:
ते हयान् कान्चन आपीडन् ध्वजांश च अग्नि शैखा उपमान् |
आप्लुत्य दशानैस् तीक्ष्णैर् भीम कोपा व्यदारयन्
वानरा बलिनो युद्धेऽक्षोभयन् राक्षसीं चमूम् |
verses.iast:
te hayān kāncana āpīḍan dhvajāṃśa ca agni śaikhā upamān |
āplutya daśānais tīkṣṇair bhīma kopā vyadārayan
vānarā balino yuddhe'kśobhayan rākṣasīṃ camūm |
verses.translation: Those strong monkeys with a terrific rage leapt forward and tore asunder by their sharp teeth, the steeds with gold ornaments on their head, the serpentine banners and frightened the demoniac army.

glosses.meaning: with gold ornaments on their head

verses.devanagari:
कुन्जरान् कुन्जर आरोहान् पताका ध्वजिनो रथान्
चकर्षुश च ददंशौश च दशानैह् क्रोध मूर्चिताः |
verses.iast:
kunjarān kunjara ārohān patākā dhvajino rathān
cakarṣuśa ca dadaṃśauśa ca daśānaih krodha mūrcitāḥ |
verses.translation: Agitated with anger, the monkeys dragged the elephants and those mounted on them and also the chariots with their banners and flag-staffs duly breaking them to pieces with their teeth.

glosses.meaning: and those mounted on the elephants

verses.devanagari:
लक्ष्मणश च अपि रामश च शारैर् आशैइ विष उमपैः
दृशय अदृशयानि रक्षांसि प्रवराणि निजघ्नतुः |
verses.iast:
lakṣmaṇaśa ca api rāmaśa ca śārair āśaii viṣa umapaiḥ
dṛśaya adṛśayāni rakṣāṃsi pravarāṇi nijaghnatuḥ |
verses.translation: Rama and Lakshmana killed the foremost of the demons, both those who were visible and those who were invisible, with their arrows resembling venomous snakes.

glosses.meaning: both those who were visible and those who were invisible

verses.devanagari:
तुरम्ग खुर विध्वस्तम् रथ नेमि समुद्धतम्
रुरोध कर्ण नेत्राणिण्युध्यताम् धरणी रजः |
verses.iast:
turamga khura vidhvastam ratha nemi samuddhatam
rurodha karṇa netrāṇiṇyudhyatām dharaṇī rajaḥ |
verses.translation: The dust rising from the hooves of horses and the wheels of the chariots blocked the ears and the eyes of the combatants.

glosses.meaning: rising from the hooves of the horses
and the wheels of the chariots

verses.devanagari:
वर्तमाने तथा घोरे सम्ग्रामे लोम हर्षणे
रुधिर उदा महा वेगा नद्यस् तत्र प्रसुस्रुवुः |
verses.iast:
vartamāne tathā ghore samgrāme loma harṣaṇe
rudhira udā mahā vegā nadyas tatra prasusruvuḥ |
verses.translation: While that terrible battle was taking place, causing the hair to bristle; very terrible rivers with streams of blood were flowing there.

verses.devanagari:
ततो भेरी मृदन्गानाम् पणवानाम् च निस्वनः
शान्ख वेणु स्वन उन्मिशरह् सम्बभूव अद्भुत उपमः |
verses.iast:
tato bherī mṛdangānām paṇavānām ca nisvanaḥ
śānkha veṇu svana unmiśarah sambabhūva adbhuta upamaḥ |
verses.translation: There arose a marvelous sound of kettle drums and tabors, mixed with the sounds of counches, fellies of chariot-wheels and drums.

glosses.meaning: mixed with the sounds of couches and fellies of chariot-wheels

verses.devanagari:
हयानाम् स्तनमानानाम् राक्षसानाम् च निस्वनः
शस्त्राणाम् वानराणाम् च सम्बभूव अतिदारुणः |
verses.iast:
hayānām stanamānānām rākṣasānām ca nisvanaḥ
śastrāṇām vānarāṇām ca sambabhūva atidāruṇaḥ |
verses.translation: There appeared a terrific sound resonated by horses, demons and monkeys being wounded.

verses.devanagari:
हतैर्वानरमुख्येश्च शक्तिशूलपरश्वधैः
निहतैः पर्वताकारै राक्षसैः कामरूपिभिः |
शस्त्र पुष्प उपहारा च तत्र आसीद् युद्ध मेदिनी
दुर्ज्नेया दुर्निवेशाअ च शओणित आस्रव कर्दमा |
verses.iast:
hatairvānaramukhyeśca śaktiśūlaparaśvadhaiḥ
nihataiḥ parvatākārai rākṣasaiḥ kāmarūpibhiḥ |
śastra puṣpa upahārā ca tatra āsīd yuddha medinī
durjneyā durniveśāa ca śaoṇita āsrava kardamā |
verses.translation: The assassinated great monkeys, spears, maces, axes and the slaughtered demons, who were able to change their form at will and with their bodies appearing like mountains were lying there on the battle-field. And those weapons appeared to be offered up as a profusion of flowers by the earth, which became hidden and rendered impassable by the slime formed out of streams of blood.

glosses.meaning: who were able to change their form at will
with their bodies appearing like mountains
those weapons appeared to be offered up as a profusion of flowers (by the earth)
by the slime formed out of streams of blood.

verses.devanagari:
सा बभूव निशाअ घोरा हरि राक्षस हारिणी
काल रात्री इव भूतानाम् सर्वेषाम् दुरतिक्रमा |
verses.iast:
sā babhūva niśāa ghorā hari rākṣasa hāriṇī
kāla rātrī iva bhūtānām sarveṣām duratikramā |
verses.translation: That fatal night became as calamitous to the monkeys and demons, as a night of dissolution, which is difficult to be overcome by all beings.

glosses.meaning: as calamitous to the monkeys and demons
which is difficult to be overcome

verses.devanagari:
ततस् ते राक्षसास् तत्र तस्मिंस् तमसि दारुणे
रामम् एव अभ्यधावन्त सम्हृष्टा शार वृष्टिभिः |
verses.iast:
tatas te rākṣasās tatra tasmiṃs tamasi dāruṇe
rāmam eva abhyadhāvanta samhṛṣṭā śāra vṛṣṭibhiḥ |
verses.translation: In that very terrible darkness, those demons thrilling with rapture attacked Rama with showers of arrows.

verses.devanagari:
तेषाम् आपतताम् शाब्दह् क्रुद्धानाम् अभिगर्जताम्
उद्वर्त;इव सप्तानाम् समुद्राणाम् अभूत् स्वनः |
verses.iast:
teṣām āpatatām śābdah kruddhānām abhigarjatām
udvarta;iva saptānām samudrāṇām abhūt svanaḥ |
verses.translation: Yelling in fury, the sound of those demons approaching in order to assault Rama was like the noise of the oceans at the time of destruction of all the creatures.

verses.devanagari:
तेषाम् रामह् शारैह् षड्भिह् षड् जघान निशाअ चरान्
निमेष अन्तर मात्रेण शैतैर् अग्नि शैख उपमैः |
verses.iast:
teṣām rāmah śāraih ṣaḍbhih ṣaḍ jaghāna niśāa carān
nimeṣa antara mātreṇa śaitair agni śaikha upamaiḥ |
verses.translation: Within a twinkling of an eye, Rama with six sharp arrows resembling tongues of flame, struck down six of those demons.

glosses.meaning: within a twinkling of an eye

verses.devanagari:
यज्न शात्रुश च दुर्धर्षो महा पार्शव महा उदरौ
वज्र दम्ष्ट्रो महा कायस् तौ च उभौ शौक सारणौ |
ते तु रामेण बाण ओघह् सर्व मर्मसु ताडिताः
युद्धाद् अपसृतास् तत्र सावशएष आयुषो अभवन् |
verses.iast:
yajna śātruśa ca durdharṣo mahā pārśava mahā udarau
vajra damṣṭro mahā kāyas tau ca ubhau śauka sāraṇau |
te tu rāmeṇa bāṇa oghah sarva marmasu tāḍitāḥ
yuddhād apasṛtās tatra sāvaśaeṣa āyuṣo abhavan |
verses.translation: The unconquerable Yagnashatru, Mahaparashva, Mahodara, the giant bodied Vajradamshtra, both Shuka and Sarana - all those six having been beaten by Rama on their vital organs with a flood of his arrows, retreated from the battle and somehow survived for the rest of their life.

glosses.meaning: the ones left with the remainder of their life.

verses.devanagari:
ततः कान्चन चित्र अन्गैह् शारैर् अग्नि शैख उपमैः |
दिशाश चकार विमलाह् प्रदिशाश च महा बलः
verses.iast:
tataḥ kāncana citra angaih śārair agni śaikha upamaiḥ |
diśāśa cakāra vimalāh pradiśāśa ca mahā balaḥ
verses.translation: Rama the great warrior, merely within an instant, made the quarters and the intermediate quarters, clear of all the demons, by his arrows resembling flames of fire.

verses.devanagari:
ये त्वन्ये राक्षसा वीरा रामस्य अभिमुखे स्थिताः
ते अपि नष्टाह् समासाद्य पतम्गा;इव पावकम् |
verses.iast:
ye tvanye rākṣasā vīrā rāmasya abhimukhe sthitāḥ
te api naṣṭāh samāsādya patamgā;iva pāvakam |
verses.translation: The other valiant demons, who were standing with their face turning towards Rama, also perished like moths, having encountered the same fire.

verses.devanagari:
सुवर्ण पुन्खैर् विशैखैह् सम्पतद्भिह् सहस्रशाः
बभूव रजनी चित्रा ख द्योतैर् इव शाअरदी |
verses.iast:
suvarṇa punkhair viśaikhaih sampatadbhih sahasraśāḥ
babhūva rajanī citrā kha dyotair iva śāaradī |
verses.translation: That night, with the golden shafts of arrows, flying on all sides, appeared bright-coloured, like an autumnal night with its fire-flies on all sides.

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसानाम् च निनदैर् हरीणाम् च अपि गर्जितैः
सा बभूव निशाअ घोरा भूयो घोरतरा तदा |
verses.iast:
rākṣasānām ca ninadair harīṇām ca api garjitaiḥ
sā babhūva niśāa ghorā bhūyo ghoratarā tadā |
verses.translation: The terrible night on that day became more terrible again by the sound of kettle-drums and by the roaring sounds of the demons.

verses.devanagari:
तेन शाब्देन महता प्रवृद्धेन समन्ततः
त्रिकूटह् कन्दर आकीर्णह् प्रव्याहरद् इव अचलः |
verses.iast:
tena śābdena mahatā pravṛddhena samantataḥ
trikūṭah kandara ākīrṇah pravyāharad iva acalaḥ |
verses.translation: By that great sound, which re-echoed on all sides, the mountain Trikuta, full of caves, appeared to be uttering confused murmurs.

glosses.meaning: appeared to be uttering confused murmurs.

verses.devanagari:
गो लान्गूला महा कायास् तमसा तुल्य वर्चसः
सम्परिष्वज्य बाहुभ्याम् भक्षयन् रजनी चरान् |
verses.iast:
go lāngūlā mahā kāyās tamasā tulya varcasaḥ
sampariṣvajya bāhubhyām bhakṣayan rajanī carān |
verses.translation: Long-tailed and black faced monkeys with their gigantic bodies and dark-like figure, crushed the demons with their arms and allowed them to be eaten (by jackals, vultures etc).

glosses.meaning: and allowed them to be devoured (by jackals

verses.devanagari:
अन्गदस् तु रणे शात्रुम् निहन्तुम् समुपस्थितः
रावणेर् निजघान आशौ सारथिम् च हयान् अपि |
verses.iast:
angadas tu raṇe śātrum nihantum samupasthitaḥ
rāvaṇer nijaghāna āśau sārathim ca hayān api |
verses.translation: Angada on his part, who came to annihilate the enemies in that battle-field, struck Indrajit, his charioteer and the horses all at once.

verses.devanagari:
वर्तमाने तदा घोरे सम्ग्रामे भृशदारुणे
इन्द्रजित् तु रथम् त्यक्त्वा हत अशवो हत सारथिः |
अन्गदेन महा मायस् तत्र एव अन्तर् अधीयत
verses.iast:
vartamāne tadā ghore samgrāme bhṛśadāruṇe
indrajit tu ratham tyaktvā hata aśavo hata sārathiḥ |
angadena mahā māyas tatra eva antar adhīyata
verses.translation: While that awful and very intense battle was going on, Indrajit a great trickster, leaving the chariot, with its horses and charioteer killed by Angada, vanished from that very spot itself.

verses.devanagari:
तत्कर्म वालिपुत्रस्य सर्वे देवाः सहर्षिभिः |
तुष्टुवुः पूजनार्हस्य तौ चोभौ रामलक्ष्मणौ
verses.iast:
tatkarma vāliputrasya sarve devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ |
tuṣṭuvuḥ pūjanārhasya tau cobhau rāmalakṣmaṇau
verses.translation: All the celestials, both Rama and Lakshmana together with all sages were pleased with that act of the venerable Angada the son of Vali.

verses.devanagari:
प्रभावं सर्वभूतानि विदुरिन्द्रजितो युधि |
ततस्तेन महात्मानम् दृष्ट्वा तुष्टाः प्रधर्षितम्
verses.iast:
prabhāvaṃ sarvabhūtāni vidurindrajito yudhi |
tatastena mahātmānam dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭāḥ pradharṣitam
verses.translation: Since all the living beings knew the supernatural powers of Indrajit in battle, they were pleased on seeing that highly gifted demon being defeated by Angada.

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रहृष्टाः कपयः ससुग्रीवविभीषणाः |
साधुसाध्विति नेदुश्च दृष्ट्वा शत्रुम् पराजितम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ kapayaḥ sasugrīvavibhīṣaṇāḥ |
sādhusādhviti neduśca dṛṣṭvā śatrum parājitam
verses.translation: Seeing the enemy defeated, those monkeys along with Sugreeva and Vibhishana were delighted and praised Angada as an efficient warrior.

verses.devanagari:
इन्द्रजित्तु तदानेन निर्जितो भीमकर्मणा |
संयुगे वालिपुत्रेण क्रोधं चक्रे सुदारुणम्
verses.iast:
indrajittu tadānena nirjito bhīmakarmaṇā |
saṃyuge vāliputreṇa krodhaṃ cakre sudāruṇam
verses.translation: Indrajit, on the other hand, then was driven to a very terrible rage, as he was defeated in battle by Angada the son of Vali a dreadful monkey.

glosses.meaning: by this Angada the son of wind-god

verses.devanagari:
सो अन्तर्धान गतह् पापो रावणी रण कर्कशाः |
ब्रह्म दत्त वरो वीरो रावणिह् क्रोध मूर्चितः
verses.iast:
so antardhāna gatah pāpo rāvaṇī raṇa karkaśāḥ |
brahma datta varo vīro rāvaṇih krodha mūrcitaḥ
verses.translation: That Indrajit the son of Ravana, the sinful demon who had gone out of sight and was cruel in battle, rendered himself as invisible again and hurled forth sharp arrows, bright as lightning.

glosses.meaning: that Indrajit the son of Ravana
who had gone out of sight

verses.devanagari:
रामं च लक्ष्मणम् चैव घोरैर्नागमयैः शरैः |
बिभेद समरे क्रुद्धः सर्वगात्रेषु राघवौ
verses.iast:
rāmaṃ ca lakṣmaṇam caiva ghorairnāgamayaiḥ śaraiḥ |
bibheda samare kruddhaḥ sarvagātreṣu rāghavau
verses.translation: Being enraged in battle, Indrajit bursted out serpent-like terrible arrows into all the limbs of Rama and Lakshmana who were born in Raghu dynasty.

verses.devanagari:
मायया संवृतस्तत्र मोहयन् राघवौ युधि |
अदृशयो निशैतान् बाणान् मुमोच अशानि वर्चसः
बबन्ध शरबन्धेन भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ |
verses.iast:
māyayā saṃvṛtastatra mohayan rāghavau yudhi |
adṛśayo niśaitān bāṇān mumoca aśāni varcasaḥ
babandha śarabandhena bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau |
verses.translation: Enveloped by illusion, he sought to confuse Rama and Lakshmana in the struggle there and invisible to all beings through his magic arts, Indrajit the ranger of the night bound those two brothers Rama and Lakshmana with a net work of arrows.

glosses.meaning: Indrajit the ranger of the night
with a net work of arrows.

verses.devanagari:
तेन रौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ क्रुद्धेनाशीविषैः शरैः
सहसाभिहतौ वीरौ तदा प्रैक्षन्त वानराः |
verses.iast:
tena rau puruṣavyāghrau kruddhenāśīviṣaiḥ śaraiḥ
sahasābhihatau vīrau tadā praikṣanta vānarāḥ |
verses.translation: Then, the monkeys saw the two warriors, those lions among men, being wounded quickly by the serpentine arrows of that enraged demons.

verses.devanagari:
प्रकाशरूपस्तु तदा न शक्त |
स्तौ बाधितुं राक्षसराजपुत्रः |
मायां प्रयोक्तुं समुपाजगाम |
बबन्ध तौ राजसुतौ दुरात्मा
verses.iast:
prakāśarūpastu tadā na śakta |
stau bādhituṃ rākṣasarājaputraḥ |
māyāṃ prayoktuṃ samupājagāma |
babandha tau rājasutau durātmā
verses.translation: Not being able to hurt those two princes in his manifest form, Indrajit the son of the king of demons with his perverse mind, had recourse to magic in order to make them captive.

glosses.meaning: the son of the king of demons
in order to make the princes captive.
